additional_info.subject: RE: 0377517 - ID0377517-DC/Si-D/FR- [ MP / R3 170001702] Payment Terminal Issue CRM:02023000119
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-FR Team,
The customer has reported that the payment terminal has not been working since August 19, 2024, an error related to the Payment Terminal has been flagged but typically rebooting resolves the issue. According to Worldline, the payment terminal requires replacement. Before confirming feasibility and connections to the payment terminal, we need to check. If the issue persists, the payment terminal will be replaced.
Please provide the MLFB number for the payment terminal.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0377517 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) to
the
eMobility RC-
FR
